note: Fixed observation criteria per use. A criterion a purpose does not list is reported as unknown (not judged), never guessed. Values are the model's subjective reading, kept with their probabilities.

question.instructions: Is there one clearly visible main subject in this video frame (a person, an animal or a vehicle)?
How strong is the action at this instant of the video?
criteria: The peak of the action: the most dynamic instant

question.instructions: How sharp is the main subject in this frame?

criteria.heavy_blur: Heavy blur; the subject is hard to make out

question.instructions: How well is the main subject framed?
criteria: The main subject is cut off, tiny or badly placed
Well framed: the subject is clear and well placed

question.instructions: Is a face visible, and can its expression be read?

criteria.readable: A face is visible and its expression is easy to read
criteria.hard_to_read: A face is visible but the expression is hard to read

unobserved.no_face: no face visible in the frame

question.instructions: Is a person who appears to be speaking clearly visible, with the face toward the camera?
How readable is the text on screen in this frame?
criteria: Text is unreadable or there is no text

question.instructions: The state is the automatic transcript of one spoken segment of a video (it may contain recognition errors). Is it a complete utterance that could be used as a standalone clip?

criteria.fragment: Cut off, unfinished or only filler

action.label: 動作ピーク（主役・ピーク・ブレ・構図・表情）
action.query: the peak moment of an action, a person moving

talk.label: 会話（発話の完結性・話者・表情・構図・ブレ）
talk.query: a person speaking to the camera

screen.label: 画面の可読性（文字・ブレ・構図）
screen.query: readable text on a computer screen
